GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (2 May 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1651)
APO 500
2 May 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Lepers to Ryukyus.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file and subject as above, (SCAPIN 1627), dated 24 April 1947.
b. C.L.O. No. 1961(RF), dated 22 March 1947, subject as above.
2. Authority is hereby granted to repatriate to Okinawa the 29 additional lepers mentioned in reference 1 b above. The provisions of reference 1 a above apply.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
